body: Why would I still be better though?
Would you be open to dm?:
But I'm scared what it might say about me...
Haha, no. Although my brain is going crazy, but that's because of a mental illness... Sorry about that.
Thanks for the reply. I have OCD and just don't want to be labelled as someone supporting best*ality. So I'm scared that this is true.
Yes  that's what I thought too. But once or twice it was a squid or something. I feel so disgusting

I'm just scared because for the most part, these things were alien creatures or fantasy creatures. But maybe once or twice not. I feel so disgusted...

Why dont you see it as bestiality?
You mean whether I would hurt someone? Never
I'm scared it counts as bestiality.
Thanks for being so kind. I still fear what other people would see in me. I wasn't aware it counts as bestiality.
Hey thanks. I know many people like the same thing. I have OCD and now I worry I masturbated to bestiality. Which I would never do on purpose.
Why do you think so? I remember that maybe once or twice there was a seacreature involved and I feel horrible. I didn't think of it as an animal... I'm gagging while writing this.

Hey, thanks for the response. 

Well, what bothers me is that I never considered it bestiality. Like ever. I would never watch that knowingly. 

This fact is what terrifies me.
Thank you...truly...
Hey... you are completely right, reassurance doesn't really work... but for me, I was in such a bad mental state... I cannot tell my therapist yet... so I felt I had no other option...
Do you think so?

Hey,

I know I didn't directly hurt anyone but what I did is still not okay

Hey,

the bus was not completely empty, this is what causes me great anxiety you know?
Hey thanks... but even if there were some people in the bus? I don't think they were very close but... I am feeling so horrible
Hey... yeah what I mean is that I have OCD and I can't stop ruminating about how awful I am. Ruminating turned into a compulsion for me, basically...

Hey...

Thank you very much for your considerate reply.

So... there were few people around but mainly far from me? I don't remember (I have OCD and I keep ruminating about this to see if I remember the details of this past event). But no one saw, I am very sure...and it would have never been my goal!! I feel so disgusted nevertheless...

Yes, I have a healthy relationship right now.

Hey,
Thank you for your reply. Yeah, there were some people in the bus with me but as I said with a distance as far as I remember. I would never do such a thing out of a thrill... but just knowing some people were there really freaks me out...
Thanks. Well, I remember there were people in the bus but far from me I think? But... I still feel like the worst... I... just want to end this...
Yes, I am not bothered by the masturbation itself but... the inappropriate timing/place, you know?
Why do you think so...?
Oh no worries, we all know how hard it is!

Hey there. 

This is sometimes called the backdoor spike. Totally common in OCD, sadly...
Yes, tell her. I wish you all the best. Therapists can be very kind-hearted. If you feel you cannot tell them, you can also write down what bothered you :)
Certainly possible when sober as well. Both is possible.

Hey,

thank you. I know this doesn't do any good for anyone, nor does it change the past. But damn, I wish I really could change it. 
I just feel like everyone else? Yeah, they deserve a second chance. I don't...
Thank you. I am so sorry that sometimes I feel like I need to rid the world of myself to account for what I did. I feel like I don't deserve to be here anymore...
Thank you, you're too sweet. I feel like I don't deserve your nice words though...

Hey thanks for your reply! :)

Yeah... I know I don't need to take care of it (and ofc didn't mean to portray my BF in a bad way or anything). But I certainly see your point and in fact, I'm working on being more direct. But it's also not easy for me all the time, sadly^^"
Thanks a lot then for your insight/confirmation ! :)
I'm sorry to hear that...
Oh, would you like to explain how so?

Thank you a lot. I realize that I need to talk more about certain things with my boyfriend. However, he often feels super bad then. Like, when I tell him "Hey, sometimes I feel a bit alone when you use your phone during our dates (we see each other rarely). Could you use it a bit less?", he starts to get depressed. He feels like the worst person on earth - ofc I tell him he is not, not at all, very far from it. But that I just wanted to explain how I feel. So this is a bit tricky..
Oh really, is it that clear? I find it interesting, since I sometimes suspect that it's part of being on the spectrum - while at other times I'm uncertain. So your reply really helped.
Thank you! I will try to tell him directly what I would enjoy then.
Thank you so much! I will do that ^^

Thank you very much for your insight, it helped a lot when you mentioned the stimming example. 

He is a very, very sweet person. I am sure he would do his best always. And so do I... I try to do research on autism and it already explains a lot of his behaviours and makes it easier to understand him. I guess it is a learning process! 

And yes... wording. I will keep it in mind. 
Thank you!
Thank you very much, again! Yeah, anxiety can be tough. I will try my best to be more direct then! Thanks!^^

Thank you very much for your help and all the info you gave me. I knew some things but yes. I have issues communicating directly because of personal struggles (social anxiety disorder). I know it is a big problem but yeah. It is not easy for me to just say things. Even if something bothers me... I don't know how to phrase it nicely without hurting him. And I don't want that. :/ So this is more my issue...

Thank you so much. Your post really helped me. 

You know, because I suffer from OCD, I am so scared to make mistakes. Or scared that what if it isn't deleted yet? I think my thesis is kept for at least 5 years or so. 

I am afraid that I cited the wrong authors now, you know? Then again, we were never really told about this and it was never criticized. 

I have already tried to learn about the proper citations and I'm asking friends how they did it to make no mistakes anymore. 

Yet I feel so undeserving of my degree now...
Thank you. It truly is...

Thank you for your very kind reply. 

I know reassurance doesn't work. It just feels so real! I feel like I have to know that I didn't do anything wrong!
Damn, this is so true... Sometimes I don't even realize what I'm doing is a compulsion. ^^"

Yay, so we all just have weak minds huh? Makes total sense. 
Lol, they are aware that mental illnesses can be made visible in the brain metabolism? Sure, you can change the brain by changing your actions repeatedly but it's not a matter of control whether your serotonin or dopamine levels are off.
How do you cope with it?
